definitions.explanation: Vibrations that travel through air or other media and can be heard. Includes all kinds of sounds, from music to everyday noises.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きい{音|おと}を{聞|き}きました。
{音|おと}を{小|ちい}さくしてください。
{外|そと}で{大|おお}きい{音|おと}がしましたが、{何|なに}か{分|わ}かりませんでした。
examples.english: There was a loud sound outside, but I couldn't tell what it was.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}{静|しず}かな{時|とき}に{小|ちい}さい{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえると、ちょっと{怖|こわ}いです。{何|なに}の{音|おと}か{分|わ}からないからです。
examples.english: When I hear small sounds at night when it's quiet, it's a bit scary. It's because I don't know what the sound is.

notes: Different from {声|こえ} (voice) which specifically refers to sounds made by humans or animals. {音|おと} is for general sounds. Related compounds: {音楽|おんがく} (music), {足音|あしおと} (footsteps), {音声|おんせい} (audio/voice).
